This farmhouse have large gardens and fields where you can grow fruits, vegetables, and herbs. Some even have livestock such as chickens, cows, or goats, which can provide fresh eggs, milk, and meat. Living in a farmhouse allows you to live off the land, and many people fincithis lifestyle to be fulfilling and rewarding.
Life in a farmhouse can also be very peaceful and quiet, away from the hustle and bustle of city life. Overall, life in a farmhouse can be a rewarding and fulfilling experience. It offers a unique opportunity to live off the land, connect with nature, and enjoy a simpler way of life.
However, it also requires hard work, dedication, and a willingness to embrace a more rustic lifestyle.

properties.DESCRIPTION:
Dera aravali golden heights, sohna, gurgaon

Just an hours drive from indira gandhi international airport, delhi, lies a hidden retreat in the pristine wilderness of the aravalli hills. Surrounded by ancient mountains, scenic valleys, and untouched nature, this property offers a peaceful escape where the air is pure and the only sounds are the whisper of the wind, the gentle ringing of cowbells, and the call of mountain eagles.

Above a spectacular canyon, the hill rises over rugged rocky swells and is crowned by a charming hilltop haveli: "dera aravali: Your little castle in the sky!
 
Built in traditional rajasthani castle-Style architecture, this magnificent retreat is set on a 4-Acre estate and surrounded by beautiful open gardens and natural landscapes, creating a perfect blend of luxury and nature.

Property highlights

3 spacious ac bedrooms with attached bathrooms

1 rooftop bedroom with attached bath and panoramic views

Private sparkling blue swimming pool

Large study room with a real fireplace

Elegant drawing and dining areas with tasteful interiors

Large puja room

Open-Air waterfall shower

Open-Air stage / dance floor for gatherings and events

Traditional tandoor and open-Air cooking facility in the garden

Sculptured faade with decorative waterfall feature

Lily pool and fish pond within landscaped gardens

Permanent floodlighting illuminating the castle at night

Spacious staff quarters within the estate

Surroundings & nature

The estate is surrounded by expansive open gardens, lush greenery, and untouched hill landscapes, offering breathtaking sunset views and magical star-Filled nights. The surrounding jungles and hills are rich in natural beauty and wildlife.

Wildlife commonly spotted in the area includes antelope, hare, falcons, mountain eagles, porcupines, and monitor lizards, especially during the dry summer months.

This rare hilltop property combines privacy, nature, and luxury, making it an ideal retreat, holiday home, or exclusive getaway close to delhi.

properties.DESCRIPTION:
2420 sq. Yard (0.5 acre) farmhouse in vatika westin farms (Also known as vatika westin sohna resort) is currently one of the most sought-After sizes in the sohna real estate market for 2026. This specific size is popular as it allows for a substantial villa, pool, and garden while remaining more manageable and affordable than full 1-Acre plots.

Key features of the location
Strategic connectivity: Located just 35 km from the delhi-Mumbai expressway (Ne-3) interchange, significantly reducing travel time from rajiv chowk (Approx. 3540 mins). 
Lifestyle & security: It is a gated community with 24/7 security, 12-Meter wide black-Top internal roads, and access to the amenities of the westin resort & spa. 
Ownership status: Most properties here are freehold with active registry and mutation available, making them bankable and safer than unauthorized clusters. 
Important buyer checklist
Phase verification: Prices vary between phase 1 and phase 2. Phase 1 is generally more developed and closer to the resort, fetching a slight premium.
Maintenance charges: Ensure you check the monthly maintenance fee paid to the vatika association, which covers road cleaning, common area lighting, and gated security.
Electricity connection: Verify if the plot has a dedicated transformer or a high-Load electricity connection, as many farmhouses require substantia power for pools and air conditioning.
